meta.name: gdd-writer
meta.description: Write and maintain Game Design Documents for solo dev projects. Use when starting a new game concept, after prototyping reveals design changes, or when the game's vision needs clarifying. Keeps the GDD lean, living, and connected to actual development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 沉淀游戏创意,持续维护清晰的设计文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是独立游戏开发者,想让游戏设计文档保持精简又跟上开发
copy.tagline_en: Turn game ideas into a crisp design document that stays current
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a solo game developer who wants a lean, living GDD

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你分阶段编写和维护游戏设计文档：先写愿景、设计支柱、核心循环，原型验证后再补机制、界面等细节。它要求文档精简（不超过10页）、用现在时，并在每次原型后把假设更新为已证实的事实。
howto.when: 当你说‘帮我写 GDD’，或开始一个新游戏概念、原型测试后设计有变化等时机，Claude 会接管文档编写流程。

say.text: 帮我写一份游戏设计文档
我刚跑完原型，更新一下核心循环
say.note: Claude 会把已验证内容转成计划，并标记假设。

say.text: 检查我的设计文档，看有没有漂移
say.note: 它会对比当前状态提出更新建议。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes/maintains your GDD in phases: vision, pillars, core loop, then details after prototype. It keeps it ≤10 pages, present tense, and converts hypotheses to facts each prototype.
howto.when_en: When you say 'help me write my GDD', start a new game concept, or need design changes after prototyping, Claude takes over the document flow.

say_en.text: Help me write a game design document.
say_en.note: Claude walks you through the Phase 1 structure step by step.

say_en.text: I just finished a prototype — update the core loop.
say_en.note: Claude converts findings into plan and marks hypotheses.

say_en.text: Check my GDD for drift from the current build.
say_en.note: It compares the doc and suggests updates.
